Proposition
[Bounding volume ratios by $ u _r$] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0403 ↗ def:chow-ii-appd-perelman-invariants 1. appD:D.46\group Volume Ratios

If $R\leq c_1(n)r^{-2}$ on $B(p,r)$ in a closed Riemannian manifold and $0<s\leq r$, then \[ rac{\operatorname {Vol}B(p,s)}{s^n}\geq e^{-3^n(36+c_1(n))}e^{ u _r(\hat g)}, \qquad u _r(\hat g):=\inf _{0< au \leq r^2}\mu (\hat g, au )\geq u (\hat g). \]
